//: Extends the strict monorepo baseline. Node runtime, ESM. `tsc` is used only for type-checking (noEmit); production bundling is done by tsup/esbuild (see tsup.config.ts), which inlines the raw-TypeScript @sma/* workspace packages so `node dist/server.js` needs no on-the-fly transpiler. Bundler moduleResolution lets us import workspace packages and relative files without .js extensions.
